location.description: The location of the resource is critical for compliance and security purposes.
location.rationale: The location of the resource is critical for compliance and security purposes. This attribute is already covered by an implemented policy in another relevant resource. Therefore, a separate policy was not created for this resource.

qa_scorecard_id.description: A unique ID for the new QaScorecard. This ID will become the final component of the QaScorecard's resource name. If no ID is specified, a server-generated ID will be used. This value should be 4-64 characters and must match the regular expression `^[a-z0-9-]{4,64}$`. Valid characters are `a-z-`.
qa_scorecard_id.rationale: Defines the unique ID for the QaScorecard only. No direct security impact.

description.description: A text description explaining the intent of the scorecard.
description.rationale: Provides context for the scorecard's purpose. No direct security impact.

display_name.description: The user-specified display name of the scorecard.
display_name.rationale: Provides a user-friendly name for the scorecard. No direct security impact.

is_default.description: Whether the scorecard is the default one for the project. A default scorecard cannot be deleted and will always appear first in scorecard selector.
is_default.rationale: Determines the default scorecard for the project. No direct security impact.

source.rationale: Defines the source of the scorecard. No direct security impact.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Defines the project context only. No direct security impact.
